company.name: You Smell Soap
company.one_liner: Handmade soaps with funny names and bold scents.

facts.summary: A young founder makes and sells handmade soaps with jokey names and packaging, mostly online and at local shops.
highlights: The funny branding makes the soap a fun gift.
Every bar is handmade by the founder.
She wants money to grow production and quit her day job.
Handmade products are hard to make in big quantities.

real_deal.summary: Robert Herjavec offered $55,000 for 20% plus a salary, but the deal never closed after the show.

outcome.headline: The TV deal fell apart, and the company closed in 2016.
outcome.story: After filming, the investor asked for 50% instead of 20%, and the founder said no. She kept going with another investor and later sold the business, but it shut down in 2016.
